text: butor and the conduit tube the leads are passed

name: scan0089-text-0196
text: through a pair of ebonite plates (Fig. 70), moulded

name: scan0089-text-0197
text: with numbers corresponding to the numbers of the

name: scan0089-text-0198
text: distributor terminals and plugs to which the leads are

name: scan0089-text-0199
text: connected. The firing order of the cylinders, as indi-

name: scan0089-text-0200
text: cated by Fig. 71, and by the metal name-plate on each

name: scan0089-text-0201
text: engine, starting at the ignition gear end of the engine,

name: scan0089-text-0202
text: is on left-hand side, 1, 9, 5, 11, 3, 7, and on right-hand

name: scan0089-text-0203
text: side, 8, 4, 12, 6, 10, 2. The sequence through the

name: scan0089-text-0204
text: whole engine is 1L, 6R, 5L, 2R, 3L, 4R, 6L, 1R, 2L,

name: scan0089-text-0206
text: The two ignition units are timed alike, and are

name: scan0089-text-0207
text: moved in unison by operation of the hand control.

name: scan0089-text-0208
text: Each contact breaker base B has a cranked lever arm D

name: scan0089-text-0209
text: (Figs. 61 and 62) fixed by a pair of studs and nuts, the

name: scan0089-text-0210
text: two arms being cross connected by a coupling rod having

name: scan0089-text-0211
text: screwed end jaws and locknuts for adjustment to

name: scan0089-text-0212
text: length, as shown in Fig. 72. Upon one side of the

name: scan0089-text-0213
text: web of the cranked levers will be found the letter

name: scan0089-text-0214
text: “R,” upon the other side the letter “L.” When used

name: scan0089-text-0215
text: on the right-hand unit, the letter “R” is to be out-

name: scan0089-text-0216
text: ward and visible: when used on the left-hand unit, the

name: scan0089-text-0217
text: letter “L” must be outward. In every respect, save

name: scan0089-text-0218
text: for the particular way of fixing these little lever arms,

name: scan0089-text-0219
text: the two units are alike and interchangeable, and both

name: scan0089-text-0220
text: run right-handedly.. The timing control must provide

name: scan0089-text-0221
text: for a movement of 1

name: scan0089-text-0225
text: in.

name: scan0089-text-0226
text: The method of timing the ignition will be fairly

name: scan0089-text-0227
text: obvious from Fig. 72, in which the contact breakers

name: scan0089-text-0228
text: are shown just breaking at the firing point on full

name: scan0089-text-0229
text: retard, which is 10° of crankshaft movement beyond

name: scan0089-text-0230
text: top dead centre for crank No. 1 on No. 1 left-hand

name: scan0089-text-0231
text: cylinder. In this position the spring blades of the

name: scan0089-text-0232
text: driving couplings, or the driving dowels when fitted, are

name: scan0089-text-0233
text: to be in the plane of the cylinder centres as indicated,

name: scan0089-text-0234
text: and the distributor rotor brush pointing midway

name: scan0089-text-0235
text: between the auxiliary contact breaker points and the

name: scan0089-text-0236
text: little resistance coil, thus coming on No. 1L distributor

name: scan0089-text-0237
text: segment. The exact firing point may be regulated by

name: scan0090-text-0239
text: slackening off the six bolts securing each ignition unit

name: scan0090-text-0240
text: base flange to its respective camshaft housing, and

name: scan0090-text-0241
text: turning the unit in the required direction. The total

name: scan0090-text-0242
text: range so obtainable is 10° on the unit, or 20° on the

name: scan0090-text-0243
text: crankshaft, which is not only ample to cover any

name: scan0090-text-0244
text: accumulated errors in machining, but will enable the

name: scan0090-text-0245
text: timing of the ignition to be varied from the standard

name: scan0090-text-0246
text: setting if required. The regular setting is to fire at 30°

name: scan0090-text-0247
text: of crankshaft angle before top dead centre at full

name: scan0090-text-0248
text: advance, and 10° after at full retard, and this setting

name: scan0090-text-0249
text: should not be departed from without proper authority.

name: scan0090-text-0250
text: When correctly set a notch is cut in the two main

name: scan0090-text-0251
text: flanges, so that there can be no doubt of the position

name: scan0090-text-0252
text: when reassembling.

name: scan0090-text-0253
text: To check the timing electrically two means are

name: scan0090-text-0254
text: available, and either will give the required result. One

name: scan0090-text-0255
text: way is to assemble the distributor head, turn the engine

name: scan0090-text-0256
text: forward slowly by hand, and watch the ammeter to

name: scan0090-text-0257
text: show when the circuit is broken and the firing point

name: scan0090-text-0258
text: reached; this must be done on only one unit at a time,

name: scan0090-text-0259
text: unless a lead is first removed from the generator ter-

name: scan0090-text-0260
text: minal marked “GEN. ARM,” as otherwise the battery

name: scan0090-text-0261
text: would discharge through the generator (vide page 68).

name: scan0090-text-0262
text: The alternative method is to wire up a couple of

name: scan0090-text-0263
text: lamps or bells as indicated in Fig. 72. While either

name: scan0090-text-0264
text: contact breaker is closed the current will flow in the

name: scan0090-text-0265
text: corresponding circuit; but when all three contact

name: scan0090-text-0266
text: breakers of the unit have opened, the circuit will be

name: scan0090-text-0267
text: broken, and the lamp or bell will be dead. If, then, one

name: scan0090-text-0268
text: unit be timed correctly in reference to the crankshaft,

name: scan0090-text-0269
text: the other may be synchronised exactly by moving the

name: scan0090-text-0270
text: base plate until the circuit is broken, when the six bolts

name: scan0090-text-0271
text: may be locked up. The coupling rod should be dis-

name: scan0090-text-0272
text: connected when timing up for the first time, and both

name: scan0090-text-0273
text: control levers set to full retard; the coupling rod can

name: scan0090-text-0274
text: be adjusted to length and coupled up after the units

name: scan0090-text-0275
text: have been set independently. Finally, the timing

name: scan0090-text-0276
text: should be checked electrically for synchronism at full

name: scan0090-text-0277
text: advance, and if necessary any slight adjustment can

name: scan0090-text-0278
text: be made on the coupling rod to bring the two units dead

name: scan0090-text-0279
text: together. It must be remembered that, as the ignition

name: scan0090-text-0280
text: gear runs at camshaft speed, all angles as measured

name: scan0090-text-0281
text: on the contact breaker and distributor will be doubled

name: scan0090-text-0282
text: on the crankshaft. Hence the 15° of advance on the

name: scan0090-text-0283
text: contact breaker, shown in Fig. 72, corresponds to 30°

name: scan0090-text-0284
text: on the crankshaft, and the 5° of retard to 10° on the

name: scan0090-text-0285
text: crank.

name: scan0090-text-0286
text: The correct setting of the contact breaker gaps is

name: scan0090-text-0287
text: 0.012 in. at full lift, but the gaps of the two main

name: scan0090-text-0288
text: breakers of either unit may be set between the limits

name: scan0090-text-0289
text: of 0.010 to 0.013 in. if it should be necessary to bring

name: scan0091-text-0291
text: POSSIBLE TROUBLES.

name: scan0091-text-0292
text: the timing of the pair closer together. In any case, the

name: scan0091-text-0293
text: spark occurs when the later of the two main breakers

name: scan0091-text-0294
text: opens, and there should be no more than 1

name: scan0091-text-0298
text: ° between

name: scan0091-text-0299
text: them. The fibre striker pad of the auxiliary contact

name: scan0091-text-0300
text: breaker should be central on a narrow nose of the cam

name: scan0091-text-0301
text: when the main breakers are just opening on two other

name: scan0091-text-0302
text: narrow cams. To correct the relative settings of a

name: scan0091-text-0303
text: pair of main breakers, take out the split pin and slacken

name: scan0091-text-0304
text: the nut of the stud which secures the ring L (Fig. 61).

name: scan0091-text-0305
text: The ring may then be slewed about the stud at the

name: scan0091-text-0306
text: other end of the condenser, and by resetting the con-

name: scan0091-text-0307
text: tacts a close adjustment may be obtained before re-

name: scan0091-text-0308
text: locking the fixing nut.

name: scan0091-text-0309
text: The correct pressure between the contacts of the

name: scan0091-text-0310
text: contact breaker levers is from 26 to 30 oz. The pressure

name: scan0091-text-0311
text: may be adjusted by altering the effective lengths of

name: scan0091-text-0312
text: the respective springs, which, as may be noted from

name: scan0091-text-0313
text: Fig. 67, have slotted fixing holes.

name: scan0091-text-0314
text: In the whole ignition system by far the most likely

name: scan0091-text-0315
text: items to give trouble are the sparking plugs, and these

name: scan0091-text-0316
text: should be examined and cleaned as a matter of routine.

name: scan0091-text-0317
text: Misfiring to an ordinary degree, or total cutting out on

name: scan0091-text-0318
text: certain cylinders, will most probably be due to defective

name: scan0091-text-0319
text: plugs; misfiring equally all round, especially if following

name: scan0091-text-0320
text: difficulty at starting, will be due to a defect in the

name: scan0091-text-0321
text: system apart from the plugs. The running on each

name: scan0091-text-0322
text: unit may be tested independently by switching on and

name: scan0091-text-0323
text: off one at a time, as usual with magneto ignition, but

name: scan0091-text-0324
text: a certain amount of study is necessary to attain that

name: scan0091-text-0325
text: most desirable semi-instinctive knowledge of what is

name: scan0091-text-0326
text: happening, which can come only with practice.

name: scan0091-text-0327
text: In connection with testing on one unit at a time,

name: scan0091-text-0328
text: it should be noted that the voltage on the primary

name: scan0091-text-0329
text: circuit to the coils will not be constant, as in a simple

name: scan0091-text-0330
text: battery system, but may vary considerably according

name: scan0091-text-0331
text: to the conditions of the moment. Running slowly, the

name: scan0091-text-0332
text: supply is from the battery and the voltage will depend

name: scan0091-text-0333
text: upon the condition thereof; should the battery have

name: scan0091-text-0334
text: been standing some time, or need attention to the

name: scan0091-text-0335
text: electrolyte, the voltage will be low, and running may be

name: scan0091-text-0336
text: irregular, and starting difficult or impossible. As the

name: scan0091-text-0337
text: engine speeds up the generator voltage will rise until it

name: scan0091-text-0338
text: equals that of the battery—say at 600 r.p.m.; while a

name: scan0091-text-0339
text: further rise of speed will cause the generator voltage to

name: scan0091-text-0340
text: go still higher, when the battery will be on charge at a

name: scan0091-text-0341
text: rate depending upon its condition and the engine speed.

name: scan0091-text-0342
text: If the battery be in poor condition, its voltage when

name: scan0091-text-0343
text: supplying ignition current at starting or low engine

name: scan0092-text-0345
text: speeds may be no higher than about 7, or even less

name: scan0092-text-0346
text: with both ignitions on. As soon as the engine is run

name: scan0092-text-0347
text: up to some 800 r.p.m., the generator voltage will be

name: scan0092-text-0348
text: from 9 to 10, and the ignition may therefore function

name: scan0092-text-0349
text: properly. But on switching off one ignition for testing

name: scan0092-text-0350
text: purposes, the generator circuit will be broken, and the

name: scan0092-text-0351
text: ignition current will be supplied from the battery again.

name: scan0092-text-0352
text: Now, when a battery which is in poor condition is put

name: scan0092-text-0353
text: on charge, it will stand at first a high charge rate with-

name: scan0092-text-0354
text: out harm, and will almost immediately show a consider-

name: scan0092-text-0355
text: able rise in voltage. If, however, the charge be stopped

name: scan0092-text-0356
text: in a few minutes—as it would be in our case—the

name: scan0092-text-0357
text: voltage will drop again on current being drawn from

name: scan0092-text-0358
text: the battery for a very short while. It is necessary,

name: scan0092-text-0359
text: Fig. 73.

name: scan0092-text-0360
text: Main Wiring Diagram.

name: scan0093-text-0362
text: then, to allow for this, and when it is known that the

name: scan0093-text-0363
text: battery is in need of charging, the engine should be run

name: scan0093-text-0364
text: up as quickly as possible to about 700 r.p.m. on one igni-

name: scan0093-text-0365
text: tion only: if all is well with the lubrication and cooling

name: scan0093-text-0366
text: system, and the engine is running passably well, the

name: scan0093-text-0367
text: second ignition should be switched on and the speed

name: scan0093-text-0368
text: increased until the ammeter shows at least 6 amperes

name: scan0093-text-0369
text: charge rate, or even 8 or 10 amperes in extreme cases.

name: scan0093-text-0370
text: This should be continued for about half an hour, when

name: scan0093-text-0371
text: the two ignition systems may be tested independently

name: scan0093-text-0372
text: as usual, as by that time the amount of current put

name: scan0093-text-0373
text: into the battery should have brought its voltage up to a

name: scan0093-text-0374
text: workable value. This process should be followed only

name: scan0093-text-0375
text: if no well-charged spare battery be available; if possible

name: scan0093-text-0376
text: the battery should be charged before starting, as such

name: scan0093-text-0377
text: treatment is good for neither engine nor battery.

name: scan0093-text-0378
text: If the ammeter continues to show discharge (at

name: scan0093-text-0379
text: about 3 amperes) when both ignitions are switched on

name: scan0093-text-0380
text: with the engine running at 800 r.p.m., or faster, it is

name: scan0093-text-0381
text: evident that the generator is not delivering current.

name: scan0093-text-0382
text: This may be due to a broken or disconnected lead, a

name: scan0093-text-0383
text: defective switch, or a broken spring on a generator

name: scan0093-text-0384
text: brush holder. If the discharge rate, on switching on

name: scan0093-text-0385
text: the second ignition set just after starting, is abnor-

name: scan0093-text-0386
text: mally high, it may be due to a burnt-out or shorted

name: scan0093-text-0387
text: voltage regulator coil, a short circuit on either generator

name: scan0093-text-0388
text: field or armature winding, or on a brush holder, or even

name: scan0093-text-0389
text: to a broken generator spindle. If the ammeter stands

name: scan0093-text-0390
text: at zero, it is evident that the generator is carrying the

name: scan0093-text-0391
text: ignition, but not charging the battery. This will

name: scan0093-text-0392
text: probably be due to the battery having been connected

name: scan0093-text-0393
text: up wrongly; the leads should be reversed, and another

name: scan0093-text-0394
text: trial made. Unusual readings on the ammeter, but

name: scan0093-text-0395
text: with the whole system functioning, and especially if

name: scan0093-text-0396
text: the needle is far off zero with both switches off, denotes

name: scan0093-text-0397
text: a fault in the instrument itself, which must be changed

name: scan0093-text-0398
text: for a new one. No attempt may be made to repair

name: scan0093-text-0399
text: these ammeters; they must be returned to the makers

name: scan0093-text-0400
text: for attention.

name: scan0093-text-0401
text: Failure of an ignition unit may be due to any one

name: scan0093-text-0402
text: of several causes, apart from a broken wire or con-

name: scan0093-text-0403
text: nection, which are always possible; but if the battery

name: scan0093-text-0404
text: is being charged properly, there is not likely to be any-

name: scan0093-text-0405
text: thing wrong with the switch. The fault may lay in

name: scan0093-text-0406
text: the ballast resistance behind the switch, in the windings

name: scan0093-text-0407
text: of the coil, in the condenser, or, most probably, in a

name: scan0093-text-0408
text: faulty contact breaker. In any case, the engine can be

name: scan0093-text-0409
text: run for several hours on one ignition supplied from the

name: scan0093-text-0410
text: battery alone; so even if the fault be one which necessi-

name: scan0094-text-0412
text: DAILY ROUTINE.

name: scan0094-text-0413
text: tates the particular switch being off, the engine need

name: scan0094-text-0414
text: not be stopped.

name: scan0094-text-0415
text: Stuck regulator contacts are indicated by an

name: scan0094-text-0416
text: abnormally high charge rate at engine speeds of over

name: scan0094-text-0417
text: 1,000 r.p.m. or so; this should be put right immediately,

name: scan0094-text-0418
text: or the ignition coils may be damaged. To obtain access

name: scan0094-text-0419
text: to the regulator, it is merely necessary to remove the

name: scan0094-text-0420
text: two nuts from the long studs fixing the switchboard,

name: scan0094-text-0421
text: when the latter can be removed and the regulator

name: scan0094-text-0422
text: inspected through the holes cut in the instrument board.

name: scan0094-text-0423
text: (See Fig. 55.) Should the ammeter not indicate

name: scan0094-text-0424
text: charging until an unusually high engine speed is

name: scan0094-text-0425
text: reached, the cause may be the regulator contacts

name: scan0094-text-0426
text: having remained open; but this is an unlikely trouble to

name: scan0094-text-0427
text: develop.

name: scan0094-text-0428
text: The possibility of trouble can be reduced to a mini-

name: scan0094-text-0429
text: mum by the exercise of care in the daily routine inspec-

name: scan0094-text-0430
text: tion, and by cleanliness throughout. The detailed in-

name: scan0094-text-0431
text: structions for the maintenance of the battery should be

name: scan0094-text-0432
text: carefully followed, as the amount of electrolyte is so

name: scan0094-text-0433
text: small that there is no margin for neglect. The distri-

name: scan0094-text-0434
text: butor heads should be removed daily, and the brush

name: scan0094-text-0435
text: tracks wiped with a soft rag and a little petrol. At the

name: scan0094-text-0436
text: same time the contact breakers should be dusted with

name: scan0094-text-0437
text: a soft brush, and once a week the lever pivots should

name: scan0094-text-0438
text: have a drop of oil. Otherwise, practically no attention

name: scan0094-text-0439
text: is needed, and the contacts should run for many hours

name: scan0094-text-0440
text: without requiring adjustment.

name: scan0094-text-0441
text: 1. Take the voltage of the battery before each

name: scan0094-text-0442
text: day’s flying. On open circuit—that is to say, with both

name: scan0094-text-0443
text: ignitions switched off—the voltage should not be less

name: scan0094-text-0444
text: than 8 volts; with one ignition switched on, and the

name: scan0094-text-0445
text: ammeter showing a discharge of from 4 to 5 amperes,

name: scan0094-text-0446
text: the reading should be not less than 7

name: scan0094-text-0450
text: volts. Should

name: scan0094-text-0451
text: the voltages be lower, a freshly charged battery should

name: scan0094-text-0452
text: be fitted.

name: scan0094-text-0453
text: 2. Remove and clean the plugs, and set their gaps

name: scan0094-text-0454
text: to 0.015 in., renewing any plugs that appear to be of

name: scan0094-text-0455
text: doubtful soundness.

name: scan0094-text-0456
text: 3. Remove the distributor heads and examine the

name: scan0094-text-0457
text: contact breakers. The gap should be between the

name: scan0094-text-0458
text: limits of 0.010 and 0.013 in., and the points should

name: scan0094-text-0459
text: meet squarely.

name: scan0094-text-0460
text: 4. Clean the carbon brush tracks of the distributors

name: scan0094-text-0461
text: with petrol on a piece of cloth. Do not use any

name: scan0094-text-0462
text: abrasive material.

name: scan0095-text-0464
text: WEEKLY ROUTINE.

name: scan0095-text-0465
text: MONTHLY ROUTINE.

name: scan0095-text-0466
text: 5. Run over all leads, especially those on the

name: scan0095-text-0467
text: engine, examine for deterioration from oil or burning,

name: scan0095-text-0468
text: and see that all terminals are tight.

name: scan0095-text-0469
text: 6. Before starting the engine, switch on each

name: scan0095-text-0470
text: ignition system separately, and note the ammeter read-

name: scan0095-text-0471
text: ings, which should be approximately equal. It may be

name: scan0095-text-0472
text: necessary to turn the engine a few degrees backward,

name: scan0095-text-0473
text: in order to bring the main contact breakers to the

name: scan0095-text-0474
text: closed position before the full current can flow. Should

name: scan0095-text-0475
text: one system show no discharge reading, there is a

name: scan0095-text-0476
text: break in the circuit, probably due to a loose terminal

name: scan0095-text-0477
text: or very dirty contacts. Should one show an excessively

name: scan0095-text-0478
text: high discharge, there is a partial short circuit some-

name: scan0095-text-0479
text: where. To detect a short in a coil as distinct from

name: scan0095-text-0480
text: the wiring, change over the primary leads to the distri-

name: scan0095-text-0481
text: butor heads.

name: scan0095-text-0482
text: 7. Immediately the engine stops, put both ignition

name: scan0095-text-0483
text: switches to the OFF position.

name: scan0095-text-0484
text: 1. Flush the battery as already detailed, and

name: scan0095-text-0485
text: correct the acid density if necessary. Wipe the battery

name: scan0095-text-0486
text: dry and clean from acid, and smear a little vaseline

name: scan0095-text-0487
text: on the terminals before replacing it. Wipe out the

name: scan0095-text-0488
text: battery box.

name: scan0095-text-0489
text: 2. Remove the dust cover from the generator brush

name: scan0095-text-0490
text: gear, dust the commutator, etc., and, if necessary,

name: scan0095-text-0491
text: clean with petrol. See that the brushes are in order,

name: scan0095-text-0492
text: and put a few drops of thick oil on the ball bearing at

name: scan0095-text-0493
text: the top of the armature spindle.

name: scan0095-text-0494
text: 3. Clean out the contact breakers, and put a drop

name: scan0095-text-0495
text: or two of oil on the pivot bearing of each lever. Check

name: scan0095-text-0496
text: and readjust the points if required. The amount of

name: scan0095-text-0497
text: slack in the driving coupling should not allow of more

name: scan0095-text-0498
text: than about

name: scan0095-text-0502
text: in. of play at the end of the distributor

name: scan0095-text-0503
text: rotor.

name: scan0095-text-0504
text: 1. Let the weekly clean-up and inspection be, if

name: scan0095-text-0505
text: possible, more thorough than usual.

name: scan0095-text-0506
text: 2. Open out the switch, clean all contacts, and

name: scan0095-text-0507
text: put a little vaseline on the track. Inspect the resist-

name: scan0095-text-0508
text: ance coils.

name: scan0095-text-0509
text: 3. Inspect and clean the voltage regulator. The

name: scan0095-text-0510
text: gap between the contacts should be from 0.005 to

name: scan0095-text-0511
text: 0.007 in. when the blade is pressed down upon the stop-

name: scan0095-text-0512
text: pin. Work a drop of oil into the pivot bearing.

name: scan0096-text-0514
text: CHAPTER V.

name: scan0096-text-0515
text: Running Instructions.

name: scan0096-text-0516
text: MAXIMUM R.P.M.

name: scan0096-text-0517
text: The army type of Liberty engine has a high com-

name: scan0096-text-0518
text: pression ratio, for the purpose of obtaining a high power

name: scan0096-text-0519
text: Fig. 74.

name: scan0096-text-0520
text: Rear View of Engine, showing Distributors and

name: scan0096-text-0521
text: Generator.

name: scan0097-text-0523
text: PRECAUTIONS WITH A NEW ENGINE.

name: scan0097-text-0524
text: FILLING WITH OIL.

name: scan0097-text-0525
text: output at altitude: it must never be run all out near

name: scan0097-text-0526
text: the ground. Pilots and mechanics should carefully note

name: scan0097-text-0527
text: the following r.p.m. limits:—

name: scan0097-text-0528
text: Maximum speed “running up” on the ground,

name: scan0097-text-0530
text: Maximum permissible speed flying at ground level,

name: scan0097-text-0532
text: Normal full speed at or above 6,000 ft.—1,650 r.p.m.

name: scan0097-text-0533
text: Maximum permissible speed at or above 6,000 feet.—

name: scan0097-text-0535
text: If a suitable propeller is fitted, it is practically im-

name: scan0097-text-0536
text: possible to exceed 1,400 r.p.m. in ground tests.

name: scan0097-text-0537
text: The naval model has a lower compression ratio, so

name: scan0097-text-0538
text: that its maximum speed, irrespective of height, is

name: scan0097-text-0540
text: It is highly inadvisable to run a new engine at all

name: scan0097-text-0541
text: hot, as there is a considerable risk of “baking” the

name: scan0097-text-0542
text: rings into their grooves with burnt oil, a mishap which

name: scan0097-text-0543
text: can only be remedied by dismantling the engine com-

name: scan0097-text-0544
text: pletely. For this reason it is inadvisable to run on a

name: scan0097-text-0545
text: weak mixture—e.g., by testing the altitude control for

name: scan0097-text-0546
text: more than a few seconds at ground level.

name: scan0097-text-0547
text: The recommended oil is Vacuum Mobiloil BB, the

name: scan0097-text-0548
text: average consumption being eight to twelve pints

name: scan0097-text-0549
text: per hour. A safety allowance of three gallons

name: scan0097-text-0550
text: over and above the calculated consumption for

name: scan0097-text-0551
text: an intended flight must be provided. When the

name: scan0097-text-0552
text: engine is stopped after a flight, about a gallon

name: scan0097-text-0553
text: of oil will slowly drain down into the sump. The

name: scan0097-text-0554
text: scavenge pumps have a greater capacity than the pressure

name: scan0097-text-0555
text: pump, and this gallon will quickly be returned to the

name: scan0097-text-0556
text: tank when the engine is next started. It is therefore

name: scan0097-text-0557
text: necessary to allow ample clearance in the tank when re-

name: scan0097-text-0558
text: plenishing. As allowance must further be made for

name: scan0097-text-0559
text: frothing and expansion, clearance should be left in the

name: scan0097-text-0560
text: tank for about 1

name: scan0097-text-0564
text: gallons of oil, whenever the sump has

name: scan0097-text-0565
text: not been drained.

name: scan0097-text-0566
text: In winter the tank should be replenished with heated

name: scan0097-text-0567
text: oil, unless facilities are available for keeping the engine

name: scan0097-text-0568
text: warm whilst in the hangar.

name: scan0097-text-0569
text: The main thrust bearing must be filled with oil by

name: scan0097-text-0570
text: means of an oil can before each flight. Mechanics

name: scan0097-text-0571
text: should realise that the thrust housing will hold a good

name: scan0097-text-0572
text: deal of oil, and that the race cannot run dry during a

name: scan0097-text-0573
text: long flight if the housing is filled.

name: scan0098-text-0575
text: COOLING SYSTEM.

name: scan0098-text-0576
text: OIL PRESSURE.

name: scan0098-text-0577
text: A WARNING ABOUT THE SWITCHES.

name: scan0098-text-0578
text: STARTING THE ENGINE.

name: scan0098-text-0579
text: A plug beneath the lower delivery connection on the

name: scan0098-text-0580
text: pump permits all the water to be drained in frosty

name: scan0098-text-0581
text: weather. In refilling the cooling system, it is advisable

name: scan0098-text-0582
text: to raise the tail of the aeroplane, so that the system

name: scan0098-text-0583
text: will fill from the bottom upwards. Otherwise air may

name: scan0098-text-0584
text: be trapped, when the circulation will be imperfect, and

name: scan0098-text-0585
text: the machine will start on its flight with less than the full

name: scan0098-text-0586
text: complement of water.

name: scan0098-text-0587
text: After first starting up, therefore, if the pressure

name: scan0098-text-0588
text: begins to fall, and finally becomes constant at about

name: scan0098-text-0589
text: 25-30 lbs. at 1,650 r.p.m., when the oil has warmed up,

name: scan0098-text-0590
text: the circulation is almost certainly correct.

name: scan0098-text-0591
text: In very cold weather the safest method of warming

name: scan0098-text-0592
text: up the oil is to run the engine for several spells of two

name: scan0098-text-0593
text: or three minutes each, switching off between spells, so

name: scan0098-text-0594
text: that heat can reach the base chamber by conduction.

name: scan0098-text-0595
text: The camshaft is remote from the pump, and may be the

name: scan0098-text-0596
text: last component to receive proper lubrication, when the

name: scan0098-text-0597
text: circulation is very sluggish. Under such conditions

name: scan0098-text-0598
text: one of the lids may be removed from the camcase, and

name: scan0098-text-0599
text: hot oil poured in.

name: scan0098-text-0600
text: When the engine is accelerated towards its maximum

name: scan0098-text-0601
text: r.p.m., the pressure gauge should register not less

name: scan0098-text-0602
text: than 25-30 lbs.

name: scan0098-text-0603
text: The Liberty engine is liable to be started accidentally,

name: scan0098-text-0604
text: when it is warm or has just been doped, ready for

name: scan0098-text-0605
text: starting. The type of ignition employed affords a very

name: scan0098-text-0606
text: good spark: any rapid switching on and off produces

name: scan0098-text-0607
text: a crude form of make and break, and may lead to spark-

name: scan0098-text-0608
text: ing at the plugs. Special care should therefore be taken

name: scan0098-text-0609
text: to see that nobody is within reach of the propeller when

name: scan0098-text-0610
text: the switches are operated.

name: scan0098-text-0611
text: One switch only must be on contact at starting; if

name: scan0098-text-0612
text: both switches are “on” during starting or slow-running.

name: scan0098-text-0613
text: the heavy rate of discharge will run down, and will

name: scan0098-text-0614
text: injure the battery. Needless to say. both switches must

name: scan0098-text-0615
text: be kept in the off position when the engine is out of use,

name: scan0098-text-0616
text: or the battery will run down. (See pp. 68 and 93.)

name: scan0098-text-0617
text: Owing to the excellence of the spark at low speeds,

name: scan0098-text-0618
text: the engine is easy to start, despite its size. It is doped

name: scan0098-text-0619
text: via the compression cocks above the inlet manifolds or

name: scan0098-text-0620
text: by means of the doping pump in the cockpit.

name: scan0098-text-0621
text: ONE distributor switch is then put on contact, the

name: scan0098-text-0622
text: ignition being fully retarded, the throttle lever in the

name: scan0098-text-0623
text: be drawn off by either of two methods, viz.:—

name: scan0099-text-0625
text: AFTER STARTING UP.

name: scan0099-text-0626
text: SMOKY EXHAUST ON WIDE THROTTLE

name: scan0099-text-0627
text: OPENINGS.

name: scan0099-text-0628
text: minimum position, and the altitude control shut. On the

name: scan0099-text-0629
text: propeller being swung or the starter (if any) being

name: scan0099-text-0630
text: operated, the engine should start. (The Americans

name: scan0099-text-0631
text: usually pull the propeller over compression by means of

name: scan0099-text-0632
text: three mechanics who link hands in line, the left-hand

name: scan0099-text-0633
text: man pulling the propeller with his left hand, the centre

name: scan0099-text-0634
text: man pulling on the right-hand of the man at the propeller,

name: scan0099-text-0635
text: etc.) As soon as the engine fires, the ignition should be

name: scan0099-text-0636
text: fully advanced, and the second distributor head switch

name: scan0099-text-0637
text: put to “contact.” The engine cannot fire backwards,

name: scan0099-text-0638
text: as auxiliary contact-breakers cut out the ignition when a

name: scan0099-text-0639
text: backfire occurs.

name: scan0099-text-0640
text: Warning is given above against accelerating before

name: scan0099-text-0641
text: the oil is sufficiently fluid to circulate properly. The

name: scan0099-text-0642
text: larger the quantity of oil in the tank, the longer will be

name: scan0099-text-0643
text: the delay. A satisfactory oil temperature is 40° Centi-

name: scan0099-text-0644
text: grade, and this may not be attained for ten minutes in

name: scan0099-text-0645
text: cold weather, if a supply of five gallons is carried. When

name: scan0099-text-0646
text: the oil is circulating properly, the engine may be acceler-

name: scan0099-text-0647
text: rated for a revolution test up to 1,400 r.p.m. Make a

name: scan0099-text-0648
text: revolution test on each ignition set separately.

name: scan0099-text-0649
text: Should a test of the altitude control be made, the

name: scan0099-text-0650
text: tachometer should register a drop of approximately

name: scan0099-text-0651
text: 200 r.p.m. if the altitude control is fully opened for a

name: scan0099-text-0652
text: few seconds with the engine running at 1,400 r.p.m.

name: scan0099-text-0653
text: The altitude control must not be kept open for more

name: scan0099-text-0654
text: than a few seconds at ground level, or the slow-burning

name: scan0099-text-0655
text: mixture may cause the engine to catch fire.

name: scan0099-text-0656
text: A smoky exhaust is noticeable at or near full throttle

name: scan0099-text-0657
text: opening in the case of engines equipped with the H.C.7

name: scan0099-text-0658
text: carburettor. This effect passes off as the machine climbs

name: scan0099-text-0659
text: into a less dense atmosphere, and is apparently due to

name: scan0099-text-0660
text: “cracking” of the oil and petrol vapour, due to the high

name: scan0099-text-0661
text: compression ratio of the engine, the volumetric efficiency

name: scan0099-text-0662
text: of the H.C.7, and local causes peculiar to individual

name: scan0099-text-0663
text: cylinders (e.g., overheated valves or pistons, carbon de-

name: scan0099-text-0664
text: posit, or uneven mixture).

name: scan0099-text-0665
text: The matter is not serious, as the exhaust will

name: scan0099-text-0666
text: become clear, owing to decreased cylinder pressure,

name: scan0099-text-0667
text: before reaching 10,000 feet. The smoke may be de-

name: scan0099-text-0668
text: creased by slightly retarding the ignition. In any case,

name: scan0099-text-0669
text: the ignition, in flight, should be set to the point at

name: scan0099-text-0670
text: which the engine runs best from the point of view of

name: scan0099-text-0671
text: revolutions; and it should be noted that with its special

name: scan0099-text-0672
text: form of ignition the Liberty engine is sensitive to its

name: scan0099-text-0673
text: ignition control to a greater extent than occurs where

name: scan0099-text-0674
text: magnetos are used.

name: scan0100-text-0676
text: AFTER THE PRELIMINARY RUN.

name: scan0100-text-0677
text: AFTER A FLIGHT.

name: scan0100-text-0678
text: PERIODIC ATTENTIONS

name: scan0100-text-0679
text: This paragraph is included to prevent mechanics

name: scan0100-text-0680
text: from ascribing the smoky exhaust to over-large jets.

name: scan0100-text-0681
text: The standard Claudel jets (main 490 cc., pilot 200 cc.) are

name: scan0100-text-0682
text: the smallest compatible with full r.p.m. at ground level.

name: scan0100-text-0683
text: If circumstances permit, switch off the engine after

name: scan0100-text-0684
text: its preliminary run and acceleration tests, and carry out

name: scan0100-text-0685
text: the following inspections:—

name: scan0100-text-0686
text: i. The sump and camshafts should be warm.

name: scan0100-text-0687
text: ii. The cylinders, water pipes, and radiators

name: scan0100-text-0688
text: should be hot.

name: scan0100-text-0689
text: iii. See that the water pump is not excessively

name: scan0100-text-0690
text: hot, indicating that the stuffing glands are

name: scan0100-text-0691
text: too tightly packed.

name: scan0100-text-0692
text: iv. There must be no oil, petrol or water leaks.

name: scan0100-text-0693
text: Take whatever precautions are locally authorised to

name: scan0100-text-0694
text: facilitate the next start, e.g., inject a little paraffin into

name: scan0100-text-0695
text: the compression cocks, and on to the valve stems,

name: scan0100-text-0696
text: giving the engine one or two turns.

name: scan0100-text-0697
text: Refill the oil tank, unless this job is postponed in

name: scan0100-text-0698
text: order to use warm oil immediately prior to restarting.

name: scan0100-text-0699
text: Test, and, if necessary, reset the tappet clearances.

name: scan0100-text-0700
text: Overhaul all nuts.

name: scan0100-text-0701
text: Fill the main thrust with oil.

name: scan0100-text-0702
text: Clean the petrol filter, and, if ordered, all three oil

name: scan0100-text-0703
text: filters.

name: scan0100-text-0704
text: Examine, and, if necessary, clean or renew the

name: scan0100-text-0705
text: sparking plugs.

name: scan0100-text-0706
text: Inspect all ignition connections.

name: scan0100-text-0707
text: In winter, take precautions aganst frost: in

name: scan0100-text-0708
text: summer, replenish with water.

name: scan0100-text-0709
text: Verify the condition of the ignition, especially the

name: scan0100-text-0710
text: accumulator. Test the firing on each distributor

name: scan0100-text-0711
text: separately. As this ignition is of a type unfamiliar in

name: scan0100-text-0712
text: the British Services, Chapter IV. should be carefully

name: scan0100-text-0713
text: studied.

name: scan0100-text-0714
text: Refill the petrol tanks.

name: scan0100-text-0715
text: Cleanse the oil and petrol filters.

name: scan0100-text-0716
text: Overhaul and test the ignition. (See Chapter IV.)

name: scan0100-text-0717
text: Examine the high tension cables for worn or

name: scan0100-text-0718
text: perished insulation.

name: scan0100-text-0719
text: Remove and clean all the sparking plugs.

name: scan0100-text-0720
text: Cleanse the carburettors.

name: scan0100-text-0721
text: Examine the stuffing glands of the water pump.

name: scan0100-text-0722
text: Oil the joints of all the engine controls.

name: scan0101-text-0002
text: Fig. 75.

name: scan0101-text-0003
text: Three-quarter Side View of Engine.

name: scan0102-text-0005
text: CHAPTER VI.

name: scan0102-text-0006
text: Dismantling & Reassembling.

name: scan0102-text-0007
text: I.—PRELIMINARY NOTES.

name: scan0102-text-0008
text: SPECIAL HINTS.

name: scan0102-text-0009
text: The following points are standard practice in dis-

name: scan0102-text-0010
text: mantling an engine, and must be scrupulously observed.

name: scan0102-text-0011
text: 1. An engine must not be dismantled in any place

name: scan0102-text-0012
text: to which dust, sand and grit can find access.

name: scan0102-text-0013
text: 2. There must be no mixing of parts. The various

name: scan0102-text-0014
text: parts of the Liberty engine are perhaps less freely

name: scan0102-text-0015
text: stamped with identification and assembling marks than

name: scan0102-text-0016
text: is customary with European aero engines. As each

name: scan0102-text-0017
text: part is removed, it should be disposed of in a way which

name: scan0102-text-0018
text: will insure its being refitted in its original location, e.g.,

name: scan0102-text-0019
text: valves may be inverted, and slipped into their guides:

name: scan0102-text-0020
text: nuts loosely screwed back on to their studs or bolts, etc.

name: scan0102-text-0021
text: 3. As each part is removed, it should be cleaned,

name: scan0102-text-0022
text: washed in paraffin, and set on a clean, dry surface (wood,

name: scan0102-text-0023
text: not concrete) to drain. The wiping down of parts is

name: scan0102-text-0024
text: not recommended, owing to the risk of fluff and lint

name: scan0102-text-0025
text: getting into the engine.

name: scan0102-text-0026
text: 4. All petrol and oil pipes or leads must be blown

name: scan0102-text-0027
text: out with a powerful syringe.

name: scan0102-text-0028
text: 5. When a joint is made with an adhesive (e.g.,

name: scan0102-text-0029
text: gold size) or with a paper washer, all traces of the old

name: scan0102-text-0030
text: jointing material must be carefully removed before the

name: scan0102-text-0031
text: joint is remade.

name: scan0102-text-0032
text: 1. A number of “soft” washers are fitted to various

name: scan0102-text-0033
text: joints in the distribution gear. New washers will

name: scan0102-text-0034
text: probably be required in reassembling, and it is usually

name: scan0102-text-0035
text: important that the new washer should be of the original

name: scan0102-text-0036
text: thickness, as one or two of the washers affect the depth

name: scan0102-text-0037
text: to which the bevel pinions are meshed. If washers are

name: scan0102-text-0038
text: improvised, owing to lack of manufacturers’ spares, this

name: scan0102-text-0039
text: point requires watching.

name: scan0102-text-0040
text: 2. Some of the studs in the Liberty engine are not

name: scan0102-text-0041
text: too firmly fixed, especially the small studs in the car-

name: scan0102-text-0042
text: burettor, camcase, etc. The nuts on such studs should

name: scan0102-text-0043
text: be removed and replaced with care. Always refit the

name: scan0102-text-0044
text: nuts tc their original studs.

name: scan0102-text-0045
text: 3. Before assembling the camshafts with their

name: scan0102-text-0046
text: respective inclined shafts, the directions on page 121

name: scan0102-text-0047
text: should be studied: otherwise the valves and ignition

name: scan0102-text-0048
text: will have to be set without the assistance of the timing

name: scan0102-text-0049
text: marks.

name: scan0103-text-0051
text: II.—ACCESSIBILITY OF INDIVIDUAL

name: scan0103-text-0052
text: COMPONENTS.

name: scan0103-text-0053
text: THE CRANKSHAFT.

name: scan0103-text-0054
text: CARBURETTORS.

name: scan0103-text-0055
text: INDUCTION MANIFOLDS.

name: scan0103-text-0056
text: 4. If the main driving bevel of the distribution gears

name: scan0103-text-0057
text: is removed from the crankshaft during dismantling

name: scan0103-text-0058
text: operations, it must not be refitted without reference to

name: scan0103-text-0059
text: the special instructions on page 115; otherwise the

name: scan0103-text-0060
text: marks will be useless, and the engine will have to be

name: scan0103-text-0061
text: timed without regard to them. The shims between this

name: scan0103-text-0062
text: bevel and its flange are provided for setting the mesh

name: scan0103-text-0063
text: of this bevel with the horizontal bevels on the upper

name: scan0103-text-0064
text: and lower shafts. As aluminium expands under heat

name: scan0103-text-0065
text: more than steel, the depth of mesh alters as the engine

name: scan0103-text-0066
text: heats up; and the mesh should therefore be set as

name: scan0103-text-0067
text: directed on page 115. In an overhaul after a period of

name: scan0103-text-0068
text: work sufficient to produce perceptible wear, this point

name: scan0103-text-0069
text: will need careful watching.

name: scan0103-text-0070
text: The next few paragraphs deal with the handling of

name: scan0103-text-0071
text: individual components, which can be dismantled without

name: scan0103-text-0072
text: stripping the entire engine. Directions for a complete

name: scan0103-text-0073
text: overhaul follow on page 103.

name: scan0103-text-0074
text: The main bearings are housed between the cross

name: scan0103-text-0075
text: webs of the two halves of the base chamber, and are

name: scan0103-text-0076
text: not slung in caps secured by bolts to the top half, as is

name: scan0103-text-0077
text: the case with some engines. The crankshaft is therefore

name: scan0103-text-0078
text: freed whenever the sump is unbolted: and the simplest

name: scan0103-text-0079
text: way of exposing the main and big end bearings for

name: scan0103-text-0080
text: examination consists of inverting the engine on a suit-

name: scan0103-text-0081
text: able stand and unbolting the sump, leaving the cylinders

name: scan0103-text-0082
text: in position. If the bearings are in need of any serious

name: scan0103-text-0083
text: attention, the engine will of course be stripped.

name: scan0103-text-0084
text: The carburettors can easily be cleared from the Vee

name: scan0103-text-0085
text: without dismantling the induction manifolds. The air

name: scan0103-text-0086
text: intakes of the Zenith carburettors can be freed by

name: scan0103-text-0087
text: slipping their spring hooks off the securing studs, and

name: scan0103-text-0088
text: the carburettors can be dropped by unscrewing the bolts

name: scan0103-text-0089
text: which support them.

name: scan0103-text-0090
text: The induction manifolds are removable without dis-

name: scan0103-text-0091
text: mantling the cylinders. The wiring U is removed, the

name: scan0104-text-0093
text: CAMSHAFTS AND CAMCASES.

name: scan0104-text-0094
text: VALVES.

name: scan0104-text-0095
text: CYLINDERS.

name: scan0104-text-0096
text: water connections broken, the carburettors dropped, and

name: scan0104-text-0097
text: the necessary nuts removed. The holes in the manifold

name: scan0104-text-0098
text: flanges which register with the lower stud of each

name: scan0104-text-0099
text: cylinder induction port are cut in the form of a deep

name: scan0104-text-0100
text: tapering oval,, so that the manifold can swing on the

name: scan0104-text-0101
text: upper studs, as shown in Fig. 78. If one manifold is

name: scan0104-text-0102
text: held down, and the corresponding manifold of the oppo-

name: scan0104-text-0103
text: site cylinder block is pulled or tapped up gently with

name: scan0104-text-0104
text: a soft hammer, removal is usually easy. If the vertical

name: scan0104-text-0105
text: faces of the manifolds at the centre bear too hard on

name: scan0104-text-0106
text: each other, the clearance may be eased by judicious

name: scan0104-text-0107
text: filing at the point indicated in Fig. 78. This clearance

name: scan0104-text-0108
text: does not affect any joint.

name: scan0104-text-0109
text: Each camshaft, with the upper member of its in-

name: scan0104-text-0110
text: clined drive, will usually be lifted off and replaced as a

name: scan0104-text-0111
text: complete unit. The long inclined shafts are jointed

name: scan0104-text-0112
text: by splining to short inclined shafts, the joints coming

name: scan0104-text-0113
text: level with the point of entry into the base chamber (see

name: scan0104-text-0114
text: diagram on page 27). Disconnect the oil connection

name: scan0104-text-0115
text: at the front end of the camcase. Take the nuts off the

name: scan0104-text-0116
text: twelve studs securing each camcase to the cylinder heads,

name: scan0104-text-0117
text: and free the packing nut at the base of the casing of

name: scan0104-text-0118
text: the inclined drive. Raise the camcase evenly from both

name: scan0104-text-0119
text: ends.

name: scan0104-text-0120
text: If a camshaft unit is to be stripped, the seven large

name: scan0104-text-0121
text: grubscrews which fix the camshaft bushes in the cam-

name: scan0104-text-0122
text: case must be removed, or serious damage will result.

name: scan0104-text-0123
text: The camshaft may then be driven out of the case with

name: scan0104-text-0124
text: a soft drift from the front end, and will bring away the

name: scan0104-text-0125
text: bushes with it.

name: scan0104-text-0126
text: Minor attentions can be paid to the valves without

name: scan0104-text-0127
text: removing the cylinders, or even the camcase: and this

name: scan0104-text-0128
text: makeshift method may be adopted in emergencies, e.g.,

name: scan0104-text-0129
text: if one or two exhaust valves are inclined to stick.

name: scan0104-text-0130
text: Remove the camcase lid concerned. Take out the rocking

name: scan0104-text-0131
text: levers. Put the piston on T.D.C. Press down the spring

name: scan0104-text-0132
text: cap and release the split cones. Obviously, if the crankshaft

name: scan0104-text-0133
text: is turned so that the piston descends whilst the valve is

name: scan0104-text-0134
text: free, the valve can only be recovered and the spring

name: scan0104-text-0135
text: refitted by dismounting the cylinder.

name: scan0104-text-0136
text: Each cylinder is held down on the base chamber

name: scan0104-text-0137
text: by ten studs which perform no other function. One or

name: scan0105-text-0139
text: MAIN DRIVING BEVEL OF DISTRIBUTION

name: scan0105-text-0140
text: GEAR.

name: scan0105-text-0141
text: DYNAMO GENERATOR.

name: scan0105-text-0142
text: OIL AND WATER PUMPS.

name: scan0105-text-0143
text: III.—GENERAL OVERHAUL.

name: scan0105-text-0144
text: more cylinders of each block may be separately dis-

name: scan0105-text-0145
text: mantled by removing the wiring tube, induction mani-

name: scan0105-text-0146
text: fold and camshaft.

name: scan0105-text-0147
text: This bevel can be viewed through a detachable

name: scan0105-text-0148
text: cover plate at the rear of the base chamber, but the

name: scan0105-text-0149
text: bevel cannot be reset through this aperture, as it is

name: scan0105-text-0150
text: secured to a flange on the crankcase by bolts, not by

name: scan0105-text-0151
text: studs, and cannot be remounted through the orifice if

name: scan0105-text-0152
text: the nuts are unscrewed. Should the timing prove faulty

name: scan0105-text-0153
text: after the first assembly (an inexcusable blunder, seeing

name: scan0105-text-0154
text: that the various gears, etc., are plainly marked), cor-

name: scan0105-text-0155
text: rection cannot be made by freeing the camshaft bevel.

name: scan0105-text-0156
text: The simplest method of correction is described on page

name: scan0105-text-0158
text: The dynamo generator can be lifted off after

name: scan0105-text-0159
text: its flange is unbolted, as its spindle is coupled by a

name: scan0105-text-0160
text: splined joint to the vertical shaft. It is not advisable to

name: scan0105-text-0161
text: turn the crankshaft when the generator is out of posi-

name: scan0105-text-0162
text: tion: the bevel drive will then exert a lifting action on

name: scan0105-text-0163
text: the vertical shaft, which is only held down (in the absence

name: scan0105-text-0164
text: of the generator) by a small grubscrew in the top flange.

name: scan0105-text-0165
text: Should this screw have been removed, the gears may

name: scan0105-text-0166
text: conceivably jump a tooth when the crankshaft is turned,

name: scan0105-text-0167
text: and derange the timing.

name: scan0105-text-0168
text: All the pumps can be dismantled at any time without

name: scan0105-text-0169
text: disturbing other components; it is consequently a simple

name: scan0105-text-0170
text: matter to keep the oil filters (two in the rear catchpit,

name: scan0105-text-0171
text: and one in the front catchpit) absolutely clean.

name: scan0105-text-0172
text: The numbered sequence gives the order in which

name: scan0105-text-0173
text: the various units should be removed from the engine.

name: scan0105-text-0174
text: The reference numbers are retained in the first two

name: scan0105-text-0175
text: sets of notes which follow the sequence; the notes deal

name: scan0105-text-0176
text: with:—

name: scan0105-text-0177
text: (a) The removal and dismantling of each unit

name: scan0105-text-0179
text: (b) The inspection and adjustment of the

name: scan0106-text-0181
text: III.A.—DISMANTLING SEQUENCE.

name: scan0106-text-0182
text: parts after dismantling, and the re-erec-

name: scan0106-text-0183
text: tion of individual units (pp. 109—116).

name: scan0106-text-0184
text: (c) The reassembling of the engine as a whole

name: scan0106-text-0186
text: Dismount the units in the following order :—

name: scan0106-text-0187
text: 1. Propeller hub. This should only be removed

name: scan0106-text-0188
text: from the crankshaft if the shaft thrust

name: scan0106-text-0189
text: bearing or hub are defective. If no

name: scan0106-text-0190
text: defect is suspected, this operation will

name: scan0106-text-0191
text: Fig. 76.

name: scan0106-text-0192
text: Front End View of Engine.

name: scan0107-text-0194
text: NOTES ON DISMANTLING OPERATIONS.

name: scan0107-text-0195
text: probably be left till the last. Otherwise

name: scan0107-text-0196
text: the propeller will be removed, the hub

name: scan0107-text-0197
text: being left on the shaft. (In some cases the

name: scan0107-text-0198
text: hub is shrunk on with hot water, and will

name: scan0107-text-0199
text: be particularly tight.)

name: scan0107-text-0200
text: 2. Wiring U and cables. Distributor covers

name: scan0107-text-0201
text: and bases. Generator. Sparking plugs.

name: scan0107-text-0202
text: 3. Carburettors.

name: scan0107-text-0203
text: 4. Water elbows and induction manifolds.

name: scan0107-text-0204
text: 5. Camshafts, complete with upper inclined

name: scan0107-text-0205
text: shafts.

name: scan0107-text-0206
text: 6. Lower inclined shafts.

name: scan0107-text-0207
text: 7. Vertical (generator) shaft.

name: scan0107-text-0208
text: 8. Oil pump unit.

name: scan0107-text-0209
text: 9. Water pump and lower vertical shaft.

name: scan0107-text-0210
text: 10. Cylinders.

name: scan0107-text-0211
text: 11. Pistons.

name: scan0107-text-0212
text: 12. Lower half of base chamber.

name: scan0107-text-0213
text: 13. Connecting rods.

name: scan0107-text-0214
text: 14. Crankshaft.

name: scan0107-text-0215
text: 1. Propeller Hub.—As stated above, this should be

name: scan0107-text-0216
text: left on the shaft unless the shaft, thrust bearing, or hub

name: scan0107-text-0217
text: are defective. Remove the locking wire or plate. Un-

name: scan0107-text-0218
text: screw the locking (outer) nut (left-hand thread) and the

name: scan0107-text-0219
text: retaining (inner) nut (right-hand thread), taking them

name: scan0107-text-0220
text: right out of the hub. Oil the threads of both nuts

name: scan0107-text-0221
text: liberally. Screw in the inner nut as far as it will go, and

name: scan0107-text-0222
text: then unscrew it five turns. Screw in outer nut till it

name: scan0107-text-0223
text: touches the shoulder on the inner nut. The hub may now

name: scan0107-text-0224
text: Fig. 77.

name: scan0107-text-0225
text: Details of Propeller Hub.

name: scan0108-text-0227
text: (i) Hold the inner nut and shaft stationary,

name: scan0108-text-0228
text: and screw in the outer nut till the hub is

name: scan0108-text-0229
text: drawn.

name: scan0108-text-0230
text: (ii) Alternatively screw out the inner nut

name: scan0108-text-0231
text: whilst holding the outer nut and the shaft

name: scan0108-text-0232
text: stationary.

name: scan0108-text-0233
text: It may be impossible to draw the hub without heat.

name: scan0108-text-0234
text: In this case the blow-lamp should be applied evenly

name: scan0108-text-0235
text: round the barrel close up to the flange.

name: scan0108-text-0236
text: Fig. 78.

name: scan0108-text-0237
text: Mode of removing Induction Manifolds.

name: scan0108-text-0238
text: (In the sketch the R.H. manifold is being swung up.)

name: scan0108-text-0239
text: A—Tapered holes for lower studs.

name: scan0108-text-0240
text: B—Point where slight clearance is allowed.

name: scan0109-text-0242
text: 2. Ignition Details.—Disconnect cables from spark-

name: scan0109-text-0243
text: ing plugs and from distributors. Free clips of wiring U.

name: scan0109-text-0244
text: Then remove cables and wiring U as one unit.

name: scan0109-text-0245
text: Remove six bolts from each distributor flange, and

name: scan0109-text-0246
text: lift off the bases, having marked or noted the angular

name: scan0109-text-0247
text: position of each unit on the camshaft housing. Unbolt

name: scan0109-text-0248
text: base flange of generator, and lift it off.

name: scan0109-text-0249
text: 3. Carburettors.—Mode of removal obvious. The

name: scan0109-text-0250
text: air intake scoops of Zenith carburettors can be released

name: scan0109-text-0251
text: from their spring clips before the carburettors are un-

name: scan0109-text-0252
text: bolted.

name: scan0109-text-0253
text: 4. Water Elbows and Induction Manifolds.—Fig. 78

name: scan0109-text-0254
text: indicates the manner in which the induction manifolds

name: scan0109-text-0255
text: are removed.

name: scan0109-text-0256
text: 5. Camshafts.—Each of these is removed as a unit,

name: scan0109-text-0257
text: complete with the upper portion of its driving shaft.

name: scan0109-text-0258
text: Disconnect the oil pipe at the front end of camcase.

name: scan0109-text-0259
text: Unscrew packing nuts at base of long inclined

name: scan0109-text-0260
text: shafts; slide nut and felt washer up housing, tying them

name: scan0109-text-0261
text: in position if necessary.

name: scan0109-text-0262
text: Unscrew the twelve nuts securing each camcase to

name: scan0109-text-0263
text: the studs in cylinder heads.

name: scan0109-text-0264
text: Lift off unit, raising it evenly from both ends.

name: scan0109-text-0265
text: In dismantling the units notice that—

name: scan0109-text-0266
text: (i) The seven grubscrews fixing the bushes in

name: scan0109-text-0267
text: the camcase must be removed before the

name: scan0109-text-0268
text: shaft can be withdrawn.

name: scan0109-text-0269
text: (ii) The lids of the cam compartments are not

name: scan0109-text-0270
text: interchangeable, having been machined in

name: scan0109-text-0271
text: position.

name: scan0109-text-0272
text: (iii) The camshafts are not interchangeable.

name: scan0109-text-0273
text: (iv) The bearings are “stepped” in external

name: scan0109-text-0274
text: diameter from the driven end towards the

name: scan0109-text-0275
text: front. Each bearing is

name: scan0109-text-0279
text: in. larger than

name: scan0109-text-0280
text: the bearing next in front of it.

name: scan0109-text-0281
text: (v) Do not remove driven bevel gear wheel

name: scan0109-text-0282
text: from camshaft unless it is defective.

name: scan0109-text-0283
text: 6. Lower Inclined Shafts.—These lift straight out

name: scan0109-text-0284
text: when the flanges at the top are freed. The units should

name: scan0109-text-0285
text: not be dismantled, unless they are obviously defective.

name: scan0109-text-0286
text: If either unit must be taken apart, draw off the gear

name: scan0109-text-0287
text: with the special tool provided; on no account attempt to

name: scan0109-text-0288
text: drive the shaft out through the gear, as the keys will

name: scan0109-text-0289
text: not pass through the lower ball bearing.

name: scan0109-text-0290
text: 7. Vertical Shaft (Generator Drive).—Remove

name: scan0109-text-0291
text: grubscrew from flange of top bearing housing, when unit

name: scan0109-text-0292
text: will lift out. Unit must not be taken apart, unless

name: scan0109-text-0293
text: obviously defective, in which case draw gear with special

name: scan0110-text-0295
text: tool, and on no account try to drive shaft out, as the

name: scan0110-text-0296
text: keys will not clear the lower ball bearing. The top

name: scan0110-text-0297
text: bearing is clipped in its housing by a spring locking

name: scan0110-text-0298
text: wire, which can be compressed with round-nosed pliers.

name: scan0110-text-0299
text: The shims between the top ball race housing and the

name: scan0110-text-0300
text: crankcase set the mesh of the lower bevel pinion with

name: scan0110-text-0301
text: the main bevel pinion on the crankshaft.

name: scan0110-text-0302
text: 8. Oil Pump Unit.—The unit is freed from the

name: scan0110-text-0303
text: base chamber by removing nine nuts Remove the base

name: scan0110-text-0304
text: plate and lower filter. Take out the driving spindle.

name: scan0110-text-0305
text: Free the tab washer and unscrew large nut on top of

name: scan0110-text-0306
text: unit. Unscrew four bolts attaching upper cover, etc.

name: scan0110-text-0307
text: 9. Water Pump Unit.—The dismantling of this unit

name: scan0110-text-0308
text: is perfectly straightforward, except that a special tool,

name: scan0110-text-0309
text: provided in the kit, is needed to withdraw the impeller

name: scan0110-text-0310
text: from the shaft This should be done in order that the

name: scan0110-text-0311
text: shaft may be thoroughly inspected.

name: scan0110-text-0312
text: 10. Cylinders.—Method obvious. Take care that

name: scan0110-text-0313
text: pistons are not damaged against studs of base chamber.

name: scan0110-text-0314
text: 11. Pistons.—The caps at the ends of the gudgeon

name: scan0110-text-0315
text: pins may be quite free If firm they can be pulled out

name: scan0110-text-0316
text: with a screwed extractor, or tapped out from behind

name: scan0110-text-0317
text: with a soft drift The gudgeon pins should be pressed

name: scan0110-text-0318
text: out with the drift provided in the kit.

name: scan0110-text-0319
text: The remaining operations are too simple to require

name: scan0110-text-0320
text: annotation.

name: scan0110-text-0321
text: Fig. 79.

name: scan0110-text-0322
text: Water Pump Unit.

name: scan0111-text-0324
text: III.B.—REASSEMBLY OF UNITS.

name: scan0111-text-0325
text: These details have been deliberately separated from

name: scan0111-text-0326
text: the notes on dismantling. Experienced mechanics re-

name: scan0111-text-0327
text: quire no instructions on the taking down of an engine,

name: scan0111-text-0328
text: but require details as to clearances, etc. Such informa-

name: scan0111-text-0329
text: tion is supplied below under the numbers previously

name: scan0111-text-0330
text: applied to the various units.

name: scan0111-text-0331
text: 1. Propeller Hub.—Should be lapped to a fit on the

name: scan0111-text-0332
text: shaft, about .001 in. tighter at the large end of the taper

name: scan0111-text-0333
text: than the small. There must be a minimum clearance of

name: scan0111-text-0334
text: .010 in. between the top of the key and the bottom of

name: scan0111-text-0335
text: the keyway in the hub.

name: scan0111-text-0336
text: 2.—Ignition Details.—See p. 61 et seq.

name: scan0111-text-0337
text: 3. Carburettors.—Cleanse the filters. See that the

name: scan0111-text-0338
text: floats are petroltight. Blow out the various jets, etc.;

name: scan0111-text-0339
text: broaches must on no account be used. See that the

name: scan0111-text-0340
text: diffusers of Claudel carburettors are perfectly firm.

name: scan0111-text-0341
text: Remove traces of old adhesive from all jointing faces,

name: scan0111-text-0342
text: and fit new washers, where employed.

name: scan0111-text-0343
text: Fig. 80.

name: scan0111-text-0344
text: Low Compression Piston

name: scan0111-text-0345
text: (Navy type).

name: scan0112-text-0347
text: 4. Water Elbows and Induction Manifolds.—Pay

name: scan0112-text-0348
text: special attention to interior condition of all rubber hose

name: scan0112-text-0349
text: connections. Scrap old water clips. Examine all joint-

name: scan0112-text-0350
text: ing washers, seeing that they do not restrict effective

name: scan0112-text-0351
text: area of gas and water ports.

name: scan0112-text-0352
text: 5. Camshafts.—Rocking lever spindles should have

name: scan0112-text-0353
text: from .005-.010 in. end play, and from .001-.0015 in.

name: scan0112-text-0354
text: diametrical clearance. Renew any badly worn tappet

name: scan0112-text-0355
text: studs. See that rollers are free from flats and cracks;

name: scan0112-text-0356
text: rollers should have .010 in. side play in their forks, and

name: scan0112-text-0357
text: the maximum shake permissible on the roller spindle

name: scan0112-text-0358
text: is .001 in.

name: scan0112-text-0359
text: The camshaft bushes should have a clearance of

name: scan0112-text-0360
text: .001-.003 in. on the shaft—i.e., the shake should just be

name: scan0112-text-0361
text: perceptible with oil in the bearing. The rear bearing

name: scan0112-text-0362
text: should have .001-.003 in. end play between the camshaft

name: scan0112-text-0363
text: flanges.

name: scan0112-text-0364
text: Should either of the upper inclined shaft bushes

name: scan0112-text-0365
text: need replacement, the new bushes should be oiled on the

name: scan0112-text-0366
text: outside and pressed into place. They should be reamed

name: scan0112-text-0367
text: to the following sizes: upper bush, .875 in. plus or minus

name: scan0112-text-0368
text: .0005 in.; lower bush, 1.125 in. plus or minus .0005 in.

name: scan0112-text-0369
text: The camshaft bushes should have no shake in

name: scan0112-text-0370
text: their housings, but must be free enough to be turned

name: scan0112-text-0371
text: for lining up with the grubscrews. Total end play on the

name: scan0112-text-0372
text: camshaft must not exceed .008 in.

name: scan0112-text-0373
text: Fig. 81.

name: scan0112-text-0374
text: Camshaft Bearings.

name: scan0112-text-0375
text: A and A1—oil holes in plate and washer, to

name: scan0112-text-0376
text: be registered with oil duct A2 in bush.

name: scan0113-text-0378
text: The backlash in the camshaft gears must not be

name: scan0113-text-0379
text: less than .005 in. or more than .010 in.

name: scan0113-text-0380
text: Reassembling.—(a) Fit the bearings on the cam-

name: scan0113-text-0381
text: shafts in correct order, the smallest at the front end,

name: scan0113-text-0382
text: etc., remembering they are stepped by variations of

name: scan0113-text-0386
text: in. in outside diameter from front to rear. Line them

name: scan0113-text-0387
text: up to register with their grubscrews. See that the oil

name: scan0113-text-0388
text: holes in the cover plate, washer, and front bearing are

name: scan0113-text-0389
text: lined up accurately. If a new camshaft or new gear

name: scan0113-text-0390
text: wheel has to be fitted, defer fixing it until the valves

name: scan0113-text-0391
text: are timed; but be sure to insert bolts in flange before

name: scan0113-text-0392
text: rear bush is mounted on camshaft.

name: scan0113-text-0393
text: (b) Fit rocking levers and covers of cam compart-

name: scan0113-text-0394
text: ments, retaining original locations in both cases.

name: scan0113-text-0395
text: (c) Fit screwed caps and C.A. washers at front of

name: scan0113-text-0396
text: camshafts.

name: scan0113-text-0397
text: (d) Fit upper inclined shafts, with washers between

name: scan0113-text-0398
text: flanges of housing. If the original gears are refitted,

name: scan0113-text-0399
text: mesh them so that the marks are aligned on the centre

name: scan0113-text-0400
text: line of the cylinder, with the marked tooth of the driving

name: scan0113-text-0401
text: bevel at the rear of the engine.

name: scan0113-text-0402
text: Fig. 82.

name: scan0113-text-0403
text: Camshaft Bearing (showing assembling marks).

name: scan0113-text-0404
text: Fig. 83.

name: scan0113-text-0405
text: Camcase Cover (showing location mark).

name: scan0114-text-0407
text: 6. Lower Inclined Shafts.—The end play of the

name: scan0114-text-0408
text: shafts in their bearings should not exceed .004 in.

name: scan0114-text-0409
text: 7. Vertical (Generator) Shaft.—Its end play in the

name: scan0114-text-0410
text: bearings must not exceed .004 in. Shims (.002 in.

name: scan0114-text-0411
text: thick) are provided between the top ball race housing

name: scan0114-text-0412
text: and the crankcase for setting the vertical mesh with the

name: scan0114-text-0413
text: crankshaft bevel. Shims are also provided between the

name: scan0114-text-0414
text: crankshaft bevel and its flange for setting the mesh in

name: scan0114-text-0415
text: a horizontal direction (Fig. 86). The correct backlash

name: scan0114-text-0416
text: between the crankshaft bevel and the bevels of the

name: scan0114-text-0417
text: upper and lower vertical shafts is minimum .005 in.,

name: scan0114-text-0418
text: maximum .010 in. (cold).

name: scan0114-text-0419
text: 8. Oil Pump Unit.—Scrap the old tab-washer.

name: scan0114-text-0420
text: Examine the splines for wear. The minimum diametri-

name: scan0114-text-0421
text: cal clearance for all five gears in their housing is .001 in.,

name: scan0114-text-0422
text: maximum, .005 in., select for .004 in. Their end play

name: scan0114-text-0423
text: should not exceed .003 in.

name: scan0114-text-0424
text: Reassembling.—(a) Gears of pressure pump and

name: scan0114-text-0425
text: spindle of driven gear.

name: scan0114-text-0426
text: (b) Separating plate.

name: scan0114-text-0427
text: (c) The three gears of scavenge pump, and

name: scan0114-text-0428
text: spindles of driven gears.

name: scan0114-text-0429
text: (d) Upper half of pump body (register its two

name: scan0114-text-0430
text: dowel pins carefully).

name: scan0114-text-0431
text: (e) Fit washers and nuts to the four bolts of pump

name: scan0114-text-0432
text: body, and insert split pins in three of the bolts.

name: scan0114-text-0433
text: (f) Fit relief valve; pass locking wire through its

name: scan0114-text-0434
text: cage, and through the fourth bolt of pump body, left

name: scan0114-text-0435
text: without a split pin for this purpose.

name: scan0114-text-0436
text: (g) Fit lower filter, washer, and cover.

name: scan0114-text-0437
text: (h) Fit upper filter and nut, using new tab-

name: scan0114-text-0438
text: washer, bending one ear into slit in filter and another

name: scan0114-text-0439
text: ear against nut.

name: scan0114-text-0440
text: 9. Water Pump.—Examine rubber connections,

name: scan0114-text-0441
text: especially for loose inside layers. Renew pump shaft if

name: scan0114-text-0442
text: seriously roughened by rust. Examine key and keyway.

name: scan0114-text-0443
text: End play at the ball bearing should not exceed .005 in.

name: scan0114-text-0444
text: Scrap the old packing, and fit two new pieces,

name: scan0114-text-0448
text: in.

name: scan0114-text-0449
text: in diameter and about 8

name: scan0114-text-0453
text: in. long, rubbing them with

name: scan0114-text-0454
text: graphite grease. The end play of the pump spindle

name: scan0114-text-0455
text: should not exceed .010 in. The lower vertical shaft

name: scan0114-text-0456
text: operating the pump should have a diametrical clearance

name: scan0114-text-0457
text: of between .0015 in. and .0025 in. in its bush, and the

name: scan0114-text-0458
text: end play should be between .005 in. and .008 in.

name: scan0114-text-0459
text: Reassembling.—(a) Fit pump shaft and bearing in

name: scan0114-text-0460
text: bearing housing.

name: scan0115-text-0462
text: (b) Wrap a new piece of packing round shaft, and

name: scan0115-text-0463
text: press it down with the front gland.

name: scan0115-text-0464
text: (c) Compress the coiled spring and tie it up.

name: scan0115-text-0465
text: Thread it on the shaft.

name: scan0115-text-0466
text: (d) Fit the second gland and packing to the shaft.

name: scan0115-text-0467
text: (e) Fit the pump casing; insert key in shaft key-

name: scan0115-text-0468
text: way; fit impeller, and draw it into position by means of

name: scan0115-text-0469
text: the nut. Bolt up casing to ball bearing housing.

name: scan0115-text-0470
text: (f) Cut and remove the tie from the spring.

name: scan0115-text-0471
text: Impeller and shaft should turn freely; permissible end

name: scan0115-text-0472
text: play on shaft, .010 in.

name: scan0115-text-0473
text: (g) Fit washer and pump cover.

name: scan0115-text-0474
text: 10. Cylinders.—The valves and cylinders will, of

name: scan0115-text-0475
text: course, receive the usual attentions. The inside springs

name: scan0115-text-0476
text: are interchangeable; outer inlet springs have twelve

name: scan0115-text-0477
text: coils. and a strength of 23

name: scan0115-text-0481
text: lbs. when compressed to

name: scan0115-text-0486
text: in.; outer exhaust springs ten coils, and a strength

name: scan0115-text-0487
text: of 45 lbs. when compressed to 2

name: scan0115-text-0491
text: in. Test the valve

name: scan0115-text-0492
text: faces with petrol. The exhaust valve stems should

name: scan0115-text-0493
text: Fig. 84.

name: scan0115-text-0494
text: Valve.

name: scan0116-text-0496
text: show a clearance of .004-.0065 in. in their guides;

name: scan0116-text-0497
text: inlets, .002-.0045 in.

name: scan0116-text-0498
text: In reassembling, note that each valve is stamped

name: scan0116-text-0499
text: “Ex” or “In,” together with the cylinder number—

name: scan0116-text-0500
text: e.g., “R4.” Cylinders are marked with “R” or “L”

name: scan0116-text-0501
text: and a number on the edge of the base flange near the

name: scan0116-text-0502
text: water inlet connection.

name: scan0116-text-0503
text: 11. Pistons.—Aluminium pistons always develop

name: scan0116-text-0504
text: score marks in use; but a piston need not be scrapped

name: scan0116-text-0505
text: unless the scores appear fresh and extend above the

name: scan0116-text-0506
text: rings. If a piston shows marks of excessive wear on

name: scan0116-text-0507
text: one side at the bottom, and not at the top, its connecting

name: scan0116-text-0508
text: rod is untrue. The limits of clearance in the cylinders

name: scan0116-text-0509
text: are .018-.022 in.; the gudgeon pin fit in the piston,

name: scan0116-text-0510
text: minimum .00025 in. tight, maximum .00075 in. tight;

name: scan0116-text-0511
text: the limits of the gudgeon pin fit in the small end of the

name: scan0116-text-0512
text: connecting rod are minimum .00025 in., maximum

name: scan0116-text-0513
text: .00125 in. Examine the piston rings for even bearing

name: scan0116-text-0514
text: in the cylinder. The gap should be between .021 in.

name: scan0116-text-0515
text: and .041 in. Select the top ring for .003 in. up and

name: scan0116-text-0516
text: down play in its groove, the two lower rings for .002 in.;

name: scan0116-text-0517
text: but old rings should not be scrapped unless they show

name: scan0116-text-0518
text: excessive wear. As alloy pistons are soft, care

name: scan0116-text-0519
text: should be taken not to scratch them in removing rings.

name: scan0116-text-0520
text: Fig. 85.

name: scan0116-text-0521
text: Main Thrust Bearing.

name: scan0117-text-0523
text: When a piston requires replacement, the new piston

name: scan0117-text-0524
text: must be of exactly the same weight as the scrapped

name: scan0117-text-0525
text: part; the number of ounces by which each piston exceeds

name: scan0117-text-0526
text: 3 lbs. is stamped on one of the flats outside the gudgeon

name: scan0117-text-0527
text: pin bosses.

name: scan0117-text-0528
text: Reassembling.—The pistons are stamped with

name: scan0117-text-0529
text: location marks—e.g., “4R.” The pistons should be

name: scan0117-text-0530
text: mounted so that these marks face the rear of the engine.

name: scan0117-text-0531
text: 13. Connecting Rods.—The bronze bush should

name: scan0117-text-0532
text: have from .010-.020 in. side play on the crankpin,

name: scan0117-text-0533
text: and from .003-.004 in. diametrical clearance. The

name: scan0117-text-0534
text: single rod should have from .004-.008 in. side play and

name: scan0117-text-0535
text: from .005-.0065 in. diametrical clearance.

name: scan0117-text-0536
text: Worn parts should only be refitted by a skilled man.

name: scan0117-text-0537
text: 14. Crankshaft.—The crankshaft must not show

name: scan0117-text-0538
text: more than .008 in. end play. In reassembling the

name: scan0117-text-0539
text: thrust, select thick or thin washers, so that the

name: scan0117-text-0540
text: assembled bearing will not have more than .001 in. end

name: scan0117-text-0541
text: play in the crankcase grooves. Examine plugs in ends

name: scan0117-text-0542
text: of crankpins and journals. Swill and blow out all oil

name: scan0117-text-0543
text: passages. The crankshaft diametrical clearances

name: scan0117-text-0544
text: should be between .0025 in. and .00325 in.; the limits

name: scan0117-text-0545
text: for end play in the journal bearings are .0575 in. mini-

name: scan0117-text-0546
text: mum and .0775 in. maximum.

name: scan0117-text-0547
text: Examine key, keyway, and hub taper, if the hub is

name: scan0117-text-0548
text: removed. Inspect main distribution gear wheel for wear.

name: scan0117-text-0549
text: Reassembling.—Bolt the gear wheel to its flange so

name: scan0117-text-0550
text: that tooth marked “O” is in line with “O” on crank-

name: scan0117-text-0551
text: shaft flange. The shims behind this gear wheel deter

name: scan0117-text-0552
text: Fig. 86.

name: scan0117-text-0553
text: Mounting of Main Driving Bevel on Crankshaft.

name: scan0118-text-0555
text: III.c.—NOTES ON RE-ERECTION.

name: scan0118-text-0556
text: mine the longitudinal mesh; if nothing has been done

name: scan0118-text-0557
text: to the engine which may affect an originally correct

name: scan0118-text-0558
text: setting, replace the shims; otherwise test for backlash

name: scan0118-text-0559
text: carefully during erection, and, if necessary, vary the

name: scan0118-text-0560
text: shims. Propeller hubs should only be refitted by a skilled

name: scan0118-text-0561
text: man. A clearance of .010 in. must exist between the

name: scan0118-text-0562
text: top of the key and the bottom of the hub keyway. When

name: scan0118-text-0563
text: the fit is known to be perfect, the hub may be re-

name: scan0118-text-0564
text: mounted by immersing it for several minutes in boiling

name: scan0118-text-0565
text: water, tapping it lightly into place, and drawing it

name: scan0118-text-0566
text: tightly home by means of the retaining nut. The lock-

name: scan0118-text-0567
text: nut need only be screwed up so that it bears snugly
